Performance

Keeps a SortingPlus inventory tidy: when an item lands out of order (gun modified, item moved, traded, marked favorite/junk) it snaps back into its sorted position in place, with no flicker and without losing your scroll position.
Enable
Master switch. When off, inventories behave like vanilla SortingPlus (items land at the end until you reopen the window).
Seamless Sort in inventory window
Keep your own inventory sorted as you modify, move or pick up items. Turn off to let items land at the end in the inventory screen (and the repair screen) until you reopen it.
Seamless Sort in loot / stash window

Keep both sides sorted while looting bodies, stashes and containers. Turn off to disable this mod's automatic loot-window sorting, including its corpse-specific layout override. SortingPlus and other mods keep their own behavior.
Seamless Sort in trade window
Keep both sale bags sorted while trading. Turn off to leave the trade screen unsorted as you move items in and out of the basket.
Re-sort on favorite / junk

When you mark an item favorite or junk (SortingPlus K / J keys or the right-click menu), re-sort it in place. Shift, disassembly and corpse/reveal rules still apply. When off, SortingPlus' own behavior is used.
Keep modified weapons in the bag

When you attach or detach a scope, silencer or grenade launcher on a weapon in your bag, the engine rebuilds the weapon and equips it to an empty weapon slot, so it jumps out of your bag into the primary / secondary slot. Turn on to move it straight back to the bag so it stays where it was. Turn off to let the engine equip it.
Temporarily prioritize ammo and attachments compatible with your equipped weapons. Your saved SortingPlus favorites are never changed.
Prioritize compatible supplies
Master switch. Move compatible ammo, scopes, suppressors and grenade launchers into the favorites group and highlight them in enabled inventories.
Apply in my inventory
Apply the priority and highlight to your own inventory and trade bag. Turn off to leave your items normally sorted while compatible supplies in loot containers and trader stock stay prioritized.
What happens to the empty slots items leave behind. Keep gaps where things were removed, keep the bag perfectly still while you disassemble, and give ammo parts their own group.
Keep gaps after removing items

When you drop, sell or stash an item and nothing else moved, leave the empty slot where it was instead of repacking everything below it. The gap fills back in next time something is added. Turn off to always repack immediately on removal.
Keep the bag still when disassembling

Pause this mod's automatic sorting while disassembly parts arrive, then settle once after the configured delay. Repeated disassembly extends the hold. Stock item placement and other mods remain active. Works independently of "Keep gaps after removing items".
Re-sort delay after disassembling (sec)

How long after your last disassembly the bag waits before the settle re-sort. 0 re-sorts the moment the parts land; higher values keep the bag still through a whole disassembly session. Each disassembly restarts the timer. Default 0 s (re-sort as soon as the parts land).
Own category for ammo parts

Sort casings, bullets and gunpowder (Ammo Maker parts) into their own group right below the ammo instead of mixing them in between the ammo boxes. Requests a sort when settings are applied, subject to the active sorting gates.
Ammo parts sort position

Where the ammo parts category sits in the overall sort order, on SortingPlus' scale where ammo is 9 and mutant parts are 10. Default 9.5 puts ammo parts right below the ammo. Lower moves them up (toward weapons and armor), higher moves them down (toward food and junk). Only matters when "Own category for ammo parts" is on. Requests a sort when settings are applied, subject to the active sorting gates.
How looted dead bodies are handled. Only dead bodies are affected on this page; stashes, containers and your own inventory follow the normal window settings.
Looted body handling

What to do with a looted dead body's items. Only dead bodies are affected; other inventories follow the normal window settings.

- Sort normally: sort the body like any container.
- Stock size-kind layout: use the same opening layout as SortingPlus' "sort npc inventories" off, then skip this mod's automatic re-sorts. This is not raw engine item order. No Looting Takes Time needed.
- Keep Looting Takes Time order: skip this mod's automatic re-sorts and leave layout management to Looting Takes Time. (Looting Takes Time only; behaves like "Sort normally" without it.)
- Sort after Looting Takes Time reveal: wait for the reveal to finish, then sort once and keep it sorted as you loot. (Looting Takes Time only.)
Sort normally
Stock size-kind layout (no auto-sort)
Keep Looting Takes Time order
Sort after Looting Takes Time reveal
Tint items you just took from a container, stash or body with a colored background, so you can see at a glance what you found. The highlight clears when you close the inventory.
Highlight new loot
Enable the new-loot highlight. Use the sliders below to choose the color.
Color - Red
Red component of the highlight color (0-255).
Color - Green
Green component of the highlight color (0-255).
Color - Blue
Blue component of the highlight color (0-255).
Intensity
Opacity of the highlight (0-255). Low values give a subtle tint; high values a strong, solid color. Default 60.

Anti-oscillation guard. Some items have an unstable sort key (e.g. a magazine while it is being bound) that can make a container re-sort every refresh and visibly churn. This detects that and briefly stops re-sorting so the list settles.
Anti-oscillation guard
Back off from re-sorting a container that is churning. Leave on unless troubleshooting.
Re-sorts before back-off
How many re-sorts of one container within a one-second window are allowed before the guard decides it is oscillating. Lower = more aggressive. Default 8.
Back-off time (sec)
How long the guard stops re-sorting an oscillating container so it can settle, then seamless sorting resumes. Default 1.5 s.
